tools.name: exaktime_list_employees
tools.description: List employees (Person records of type Employee) with name, job title, department, employee id, active/inactive status and which Arcoro modules they use. Use personId with exaktime_get_employee. GET /v1/Common/Persons/Employees.

tools.name: exaktime_list_persons
tools.description: List or search Person records (employees and API users) by first name, last name, employee identifier or work email. Returns personId, names, work email, employee id, username and whether the person is a contractor or deleted. GET /v1/Common/Persons.

tools.name: exaktime_get_person
tools.description: One Person record: names, contact details, address, login username and security groups. Government identifiers are not available through this server. GET /v1/Common/Persons/{personId}.

tools.name: exaktime_get_employee
tools.description: Employment details for a person: hire/termination date, status, employment and pay type, pay rates, job code, manager, location, department, pay schedule and union. GET /v1/Common/Persons/{personId}/Employees.

tools.name: exaktime_list_locations
tools.description: List locations (job sites and offices) with address, coordinates, active flag and whether they are used for time and attendance. GET /v1/Common/Locations.

tools.name: exaktime_get_location
tools.description: One location by id. GET /v1/Common/Locations/{id}.

tools.name: exaktime_list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs (projects) with identifier, name, active flag, dates, department, parent job and assigned locations. GET /v1/Time/Jobs.

tools.name: exaktime_get_job
tools.description: One job by id. GET /v1/Time/Jobs/{id}.

tools.name: exaktime_list_cost_codes
tools.description: List cost codes (phases and work activities that time is booked against) with identifier, name, active flag and cost type. GET /v1/Time/CostCodes.

tools.name: exaktime_get_cost_code
tools.description: One cost code by id. GET /v1/Time/CostCodes/{id}.

tools.name: exaktime_list_cost_types
tools.description: List cost types (groupings of cost codes, e.g. labor, equipment) with identifier, name and active flag. GET /v1/Time/CostTypes.

tools.name: exaktime_list_departments
tools.description: List departments with identifier, name and active flag. GET /v1/Common/Departments.

tools.name: exaktime_list_job_codes
tools.description: List job codes (positions / trades) with name, description and active flag. GET /v1/Common/JobCodes.

tools.name: exaktime_list_pay_schedules
tools.description: List pay schedules with frequency, first pay date, pay periods per year and the default flag. GET /v1/Payroll/PaySchedules.

tools.name: exaktime_list_labor_classes
tools.description: List labor classes with identifier, name and active flag. GET /v1/Payroll/LaborClasses.

tools.name: exaktime_list_rate_codes
tools.description: List payroll rate codes with identifier, name, description and whether it is the base rate. GET /v1/Payroll/RateCodes.

tools.name: exaktime_list_time_records
tools.description: List time records (timecard entries: who worked, when, on which cost code and location, regular/overtime hours). Filter by work date range, person, location or cost code identifier; newest first. Source: the read-only OData data warehouse, refreshed nightly, so today's entries may not show until tom

tools.name: exaktime_list_time_punches
tools.description: List raw clock punches (punch time, device type, location, network time difference). Filter by date range (UTC days), person or location; newest first. Source: the read-only OData data warehouse, refreshed nightly, so today's entries may not show until tomorrow. Page with skip/next_skip. GET /odata/

tools.name: exaktime_list_shifts
tools.description: List scheduled shifts (employee, start/end, title, cost code, location, notes). Filter by start date range (UTC days), person or location; newest first. Source: the read-only OData data warehouse, refreshed nightly, so today's entries may not show until tomorrow. Page with skip/next_skip. GET /odata

tools.name: exaktime_list_pay_periods
tools.description: List pay periods (id, start and end date, closed or open, type), newest first. Use the id to find approvals. Source: the read-only OData data warehouse, refreshed nightly, so today's entries may not show until tomorrow. Page with skip/next_skip. GET /odata/DwPayPeriods.

tools.name: exaktime_list_time_off_requests
tools.description: List time off requests (employee, plan, start/end date, hours, status, comments, manager). Filter by status, person or start-date range. Source: the read-only OData data warehouse, refreshed nightly, so today's entries may not show until tomorrow. Page with skip/next_skip. GET /odata/DwTimeOffReques

tools.name: exaktime_list_time_off_balances
tools.description: List time off balances per employee and plan (balance hours, maximum balance, manager). Source: the read-only OData data warehouse, refreshed nightly, so today's entries may not show until tomorrow. Page with skip/next_skip. GET /odata/DwTimeOffBalances.

tools.name: exaktime_list_timecard_approvals
tools.description: List daily timecard approvals (work date, approval type, who approved and when, the employee). Filter by work date range or employee. Source: the read-only OData data warehouse, refreshed nightly, so today's entries may not show until tomorrow. Page with skip/next_skip. GET /odata/DwWorkDateTimeAppr

tools.name: exaktime_list_pay_period_approvals
tools.description: List pay period (timesheet) approvals and sign-offs: pay period, approval type, approver, time, employee, comment. Use it to see who has not yet signed off. Source: the read-only OData data warehouse, refreshed nightly, so today's entries may not show until tomorrow. Page with skip/next_skip. GET /o

tools.name: exaktime_list_meal_break_violations
tools.description: List meal break compliance violations (type, date, expected vs actual value) linked to a time record id. Source: the read-only OData data warehouse, refreshed nightly, so today's entries may not show until tomorrow. Page with skip/next_skip. GET /odata/DwMealBreakViolations.

tools.name: exaktime_query_odata
tools.description: Read-only OData query over any Arcoro data warehouse entity set, for questions the other tools do not cover (equipment, expenses, users, time records by hour group, learning, performance, recruiting, benefits...). Entity sets start with Dw, e.g. DwUsers, DwEquipments, DwExpenses, DwCostCodes, DwLoca

tools.name: exaktime_create_job
tools.description: WRITE: create a job (project) that employees can book time to. Identifier must be unique. The job appears in Arcoro right away; it can be deactivated again with exaktime_update_job (there is no delete). POST /v1/Time/Jobs.

tools.name: exaktime_update_job
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing job (rename it, set dates, assign locations, or set is_active=false to close it). Only the fields you pass change (null clears a nullable field); the tool reads the job first and sends the full object, because Arcoro replaces the job on PUT. Two edits to the same

tools.name: exaktime_create_cost_code
tools.description: WRITE: create a cost code (phase or work activity) that time can be booked against. The name must be unique. It can be deactivated again with exaktime_update_cost_code (there is no delete). POST /v1/Time/CostCodes.

tools.name: exaktime_update_cost_code
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing cost code (rename it, change its cost type, or set is_active=false to retire it). Only the fields you pass change; the tool reads the cost code first and sends the full object. PUT /v1/Time/CostCodes/{id}.

tools.name: exaktime_create_location
tools.description: WRITE: create a location (job site or office). Add the address and/or latitude and longitude so geofencing and maps work. It can be deactivated again with exaktime_update_location (there is no delete). POST /v1/Common/Locations.

tools.name: exaktime_update_location
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing location (rename, move, new address, or set is_active=false to retire it). Only the fields you pass change; the tool reads the location first and sends the full object. PUT /v1/Common/Locations/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: exaktime_list_persons, exaktime_list_time_off_requests, exaktime_list_pay_period_approvals · Private data: exaktime_list_employees, exaktime_list_persons, exaktime_get_person, exaktime_list_time_records, exaktime_list_meal_break_violations, exaktime_query_odata · Public sink: exaktime_list_persons, exaktime_create_job, exaktime_create_cost_code, exaktime_create_location · Destructive: exaktime_create_job, exaktime_update_job, exaktime_create_cost_code, exaktime_create_location.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: exaktime_list_persons, exaktime_list_time_off_requests, exaktime_list_pay_period_approvals · Private data: exaktime_list_employees, exaktime_list_persons, exaktime_get_person, exaktime_list_time_records, exaktime_list_meal_break_violations, exaktime_query_odata · Public sink: exaktime_list_persons, exaktime_create_job, exaktime_create_cost_code, exaktime_create_location · Destructive: exaktime_create_job, exaktime_update_job, exaktime_create_cost_code, exaktime_create_location

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
